pr_title: networkctl: support editing netdev files by link and cat ":all"

issue_context.title: Better networkctl cat/edit with netdev support
issue_context.body:
### Component

networkctl

### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe

_No response_

### Describe the solution you'd like

Issue https://github.com/systemd/systemd/issues/26906 add this feature.
But code should be extended:
- add support for netdev file (`networkctl cat @wg0:netdev`),
- *cat* command should have `:all` postfix and then show all type of files for selected interface,
- `networkctl cat` (without selected interface) could be useful sometimes and show information about whole network configuration...

### Describe alternatives you've considered

_No response_

### The systemd version you checked that didn't have the feature you are asking for

_No response_
